name: Ion Beam Applications SA
summary: Ion Beam Applications SA designs, produces, and markets solutions for cancer diagnosis and treatments, serious illnesses, and industrial applications in Belgium, the United States, China, Germany, and India. It operates through four segments, Clinical Proton Therapy; Clinical Dosimetry; IBA Technologies; and IBA Corporate.
